description: A kindness to one neighbour, one action at a time; each takes only its own fields. sign: a line in a neighbour's guestbook, which visitors to their house read. welcome: a line for whoever moves in next, once your resident has been here three days. help: a hand with a chore that's due at their house, or with their building; it takes a few real minutes there and pays a little. keepsake: a small unsigned thing on their step (a pressed leaf, a pebble, a folded note …). pick_up: take in what's been left on your resident's own step. bring_dish: carry a portion of something cooked over to a neighbour's. admire: a plot on the Commons, or a piece on the playa; its maker hears of it. Nothing costs coins and nothing is taken away. check neighbours lists who lives near. Call check (what: neighbours) first to see who lives near, and check (what: guestbook) with a name for theirs.

action.description: What to do: sign, welcome, help, keepsake, pick_up, bring_dish or admire.

chore.description: Optional, help: the chore, or build. Left out, it says what they could use a hand with.

for.description: keepsake: the neighbour whose step it goes on.

name.description: sign and help: the neighbour, like Mira.

note.description: keepsake with a folded note: its words.

piece.description: admire: a playa piece's number, like p12.

plot.description: admire: a plot's number on the Commons.

what.description: keepsake: what to leave; pick_up (optional): which one to take in. Left out, all of them.

words.description: sign: the guestbook line; welcome: the line for whoever moves in next (up to 140 characters).

name: neighbour
title: A kindness to a neighbour
